description: A button with click, slide and hover-effect styling.
howItWorks: Move your mouse over it and it reacts; move away and it returns to its resting state.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Helpless Insect 19</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by Deri-Kurniawan - https://uiverse.io/Deri-Kurniawan/helpless-insect-19 */
/* From Uiverse.io by Deri-Kurniawan - Tags: button, hover, click, slide, hover effect, hover button, button hover effect  */
.button {
  position: relative;
  padding: 12px 32px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #000;
  background-color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50px;
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.button:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.button:active {
  transform: scale(0.9);
}

.button::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -100%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #007bff, #00bfff);
  transition: all 0.4s ease-in-out;
  z-index: -1;
  border-radius: 50px;
}

.button:hover::before {
  left: 0;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  hover me!
</button>
</body>
</html>
